question: How many Members of Parliament were elected from Punjab to the 17th Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 17th Lok Sabha:-**

 
 
• **The 2019 Indian general election in Punjab was held on 19 May 2019, making it seventh and the last phase of the election. **
 
• The counting was held on 23 May 2019 and result was also declared on same day.
 
• **13 Members of Parliament were elected from Punjab to the 17th Lok Sabha.**
 
• The Indian National Congress (INC) won 8 seats, while the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have won 2 seats each, and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) won 1 seat.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Sabha:-**

 
 
• It is the lower house of India's Parliament.
 
• **It is a directly elected body, meaning that its members are elected directly by the people of India. **
 
• Lok Sabha has 550 members, and each member represents a constituency.
 
• The term of a Lok Sabha member is five years.
